context.section_heading_exact: Real Garden Room Price Examples - VAT Included
context.intro_exact: A useful garden-room price should show what size and specification it relates to. PECASA publishes model examples with VAT included, giving homeowners a realistic starting point before the design is adapted to the site.
banner_exact: Premium builds, precision made. Installed in as little as 16–18 days.
context.vat_wording_exact: Prices include VAT. Final price may vary based on exact specification, site conditions and any additional options.
context.pricing_note_exact: Pricing note: These are current published model examples, not fixed quotes for every site. Bespoke dimensions, access, ground conditions, glazing, services, bathrooms/kitchenettes, AC installation, decking and other options can change the final price. The written PECASA quotation should govern the final scope and cost.
context.style_stated: not stated (table is not tied to any named style)
context.note_on_area_labels: Column/area labels give approx. m² for the 2.8 m depth only (e.g. "Approx. 8m² (e.g. 2.8 × 3.0)"); the mobile cards repeat the same m² label for every depth.

notes: Price text is "From £… (inc. Vat)"; four cards use a full stop as thousands separator (£33.200, £34.559, £38.456, £34.099).
"PECASA CLASSIC 30m2" names no style; its image is a project photo.
"NSPIRO" is how the site spells the card that the configurator calls "Inspiro".
No cards exist for Pergola, Quba, Veranda or Angle.

configurator_displayed_estimates.method: Each style tile clicked in the Style tab (no other option changed, no form submitted); label read after "Calculating price..." resolved. Two passes in different orders gave identical values.

exact: We use third party experts who charge, £600 for a full planning consultancy service to acquire planning permission or a Lawful Development Certificate, providing all elevation plans, site and location plans, design and access statement, completing the application and liaising with the Planning Team on your behalf until the planning decision is made. There are additional charges for the following requirements: Tree Plan (£75), Flood Risk Assessment (£75), Heritage, Ecosystems Services and Biodiversity/Wildlife Statements (£50).
A separate fee is payable directly to the council upon submission of the application:-

planning_fees.caveat_on_site_exact: Do not publish or rely on old application-fee figures without checking them.
